findings.test: test_test_util_absent_from_normal_graph (cargo tree, 60 s deadline) racing test_release_binary_rejects_scripted_answers (cargo build)
findings.issue: The delta's stated premise (7660d24) is that concurrent cargo invocations queue on Cargo's file locks, so TREE_LOCK serializes only the cargo tree calls. The same test binary also runs a cargo build from a parallel test thread (bin_path, via test_release_binary_rejects_scripted_answers). That build is guarded only by bin_path's own BUILD_LOCK, which TREE_LOCK does not share. The default parallel test runner can therefore run a cold release build (up to 20 min deadline, mimalloc and tree-sitter C builds) concurrently with a cargo tree call. If that cargo tree blocks on a Cargo file lock held by the build for longer than CARGO_TREE_DEADLINE (60 s), the call fails by deadline. Which timing triggers it depends on how Cargo's package-cache and build locks interact, and I could not confirm that from this environment. The gap in the serialization itself is confirmed by the code. The result is an intermittent failure that appears only when the build is cold and slow, which is the CI first-run case.
findings.recommendation: Make one lock cover every cargo invocation in this binary. Either move the TREE_LOCK static into the shared support module and take it inside bin_path before its build, or prebuild the sc-ai binary in a single serialized setup step before any tree call. Preferred: move test_release_binary_rejects_scripted_answers into its own test binary so this binary never runs a cargo build concurrently with cargo tree. Keep the 60 s tree deadline, but have it cover only the tree call, not the wait on the shared lock.
findings.evidence: test_util_off.rs:30-32 declares TREE_LOCK with the comment 'concurrent cargo invocations queue on Cargo's file locks'. test_util_off.rs:36-42 (run_tree) locks TREE_LOCK, then calls spawn_with_limit(CARGO_TREE_DEADLINE). test_util_off.rs:142-143 (test_release_binary_rejects_scripted_answers) calls bin_path('sc-ai','sc-ai') with no TREE_LOCK. bin_path.rs:30 declares a separate BUILD_LOCK. bin_path.rs:69-88 runs `cargo build --locked --release -p <pkg> --features cli` under BIN_BUILD_DEADLINE (20 min) with its own target dir, so it is cold on a fresh runner. No nextest config exists, so cargo test runs these threads in parallel inside one process. Closure checks: FTQ-004 (TREE_LOCK plus 60 s deadline, 7660d24) is in place for tree calls within one binary; FTQ-005 (bounded reap and kill, bb79cdb) is in place in deadline.rs (reap_within, bounded kill helper, PIPE_GRACE finish, no unbounded wait in the runner); FTQ-006 (elapsed assertion removed, 444ff86) is confirmed absent from all targets, including git.rs test_hung_git_is_killed_at_the_deadline.
